name: The Yardbirds
lyricQuotes: For your love / I'd give the moon and the stars above
Shapes of things before my eyes / Just teach me to despise

shortBio.en: London R&B, 1963–68. Guitarists in sequence: Clapton, Beck, then Page. For Your Love, Heart Full of Soul, and Shapes of Things are the main singles.
shortBio.zh: 伦敦 R&B，1963–68。吉他手依次为 Clapton、Beck、Page。主要单曲包括 For Your Love、Heart Full of Soul、Shapes of Things。

body.en:
The Yardbirds formed in London in 1963 as an R&B group around the Crawdaddy Club circuit. Keith Relf sang; Jim McCarty played drums. Early sets leaned on Chicago blues covers and extended live rave-ups.

Eric Clapton left in March 1965 after For Your Love. Jeff Beck then recorded Heart Full of Soul and Shapes of Things. Jimmy Page joined in 1966, first on bass then lead guitar. The band dissolved in 1968; Page formed Led Zeppelin from remaining tour dates. Clapton had already joined Cream in 1966.
body.zh:
The Yardbirds 于 1963 年在伦敦成立，起步于 Crawdaddy Club 一带的 R&B 演出。Keith Relf 主唱，Jim McCarty 打鼓。早期曲目以芝加哥蓝调翻唱与延长现场 rave-up 为主。

Eric Clapton 在 For Your Love 之后于 1965 年 3 月离队。Jeff Beck 随后录制 Heart Full of Soul 与 Shapes of Things。Jimmy Page 于 1966 年加入，先弹贝斯再转主音吉他。乐队 1968 年解散；Page 从未完成的巡演场次中组建 Led Zeppelin。Clapton 已于 1966 年加入 Cream。

whyMatters.en: London R&B band formed in 1963. Successive lead guitarists were Eric Clapton, Jeff Beck, and Jimmy Page—Clapton went to Cream; Page later formed Led Zeppelin.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦 R&B 乐队，1963 年成立。主音吉他手先后为 Eric Clapton、Jeff Beck、Jimmy Page——Clapton 去往 Cream；Page 后来组建 Led Zeppelin。

note.en: Graham Gouldman song; harpsichord pop arrangement. Clapton left soon after.
note.zh: Graham Gouldman 作品；羽管键琴流行编曲。Clapton 不久后离队。

note.en: Beck-era single. Fuzz guitar on a minor-key riff in place of a planned sitar part.
note.zh: Beck 时期单曲。原计划用 sitar，实际以 fuzz 吉他弹小调 riff。

note.en: About 2:30. Feedback swells in the solo; lyric addresses war and social change.
note.zh: 时长约 2:30。独奏含反馈延音；歌词涉及战争与社会变化。

body.en:
The Yardbirds began as a Crawdaddy Club R&B unit covering Chicago blues. Clapton’s reputation grew on extended live rave-ups.

For Your Love (1965) added harpsichord and a pop arrangement. Clapton left in March 1965, objecting to the commercial direction.

Jeff Beck took the guitar seat.
body.zh:
Yardbirds 起步于 Crawdaddy Club 的 R&B 演出，翻唱芝加哥蓝调。Clapton 的名声建立在延长现场 rave-up 上。

For Your Love（1965）加入羽管键琴与流行编曲。Clapton 于 1965 年 3 月离队，不满商业化方向。

Jeff Beck 接任吉他席位。

body.en:
Jeff Beck replaced Clapton in mid-1965. Heart Full of Soul used fuzz guitar where a sitar part had been planned. Shapes of Things added controlled feedback in the solo.

Roger the Engineer (1966; US title Over Under Sideways Down) is the main Beck-era album—Indian-scale figures, reverse tape, and rave-up endings.

Beck left after friction on a US tour. Page, already in the band, moved to lead guitar.
body.zh:
Jeff Beck 于 1965 年中接替 Clapton。Heart Full of Soul 原计划用 sitar，实际以 fuzz 吉他完成。Shapes of Things 在独奏中加入可控反馈。

Roger the Engineer（1966；美版名 Over Under Sideways Down）是 Beck 时期主要专辑——印度音阶音型、反向磁带与 rave-up 收尾。

Beck 在美国巡演摩擦后离队。已在队的 Page 转任主音吉他。

title.en: Page and the end of the band

body.en:
Jimmy Page joined first on bass, then took lead after Beck left. Dual-lead work with Chris Dreja on guitar preceded the final quartet.

Little Games (1967) was a commercial studio album; live sets still used extended blues jams and early forms of what became Dazed and Confused.

The band dissolved in 1968. Page kept tour commitments and formed Led Zeppelin from those remaining dates.
body.zh:
Jimmy Page 先入队弹贝斯，Beck 离队后转主音。与 Chris Dreja 的双主音实验之后定型为四人组。

Little Games（1967）是偏商业的录音室专辑；现场仍含延长蓝调 jam，以及后来成为 Dazed and Confused 的早期形态。

乐队 1968 年解散。Page 保留巡演义务，并从这些未完成场次中组建 Led Zeppelin。

body.en: 1965 single written by Graham Gouldman. Harpsichord and pop arrangement. Clapton left the band shortly afterward.
body.zh: 1965 年单曲，Graham Gouldman 作曲。羽管键琴与流行编曲。Clapton 不久后离队。

body.en: Beck-era 1965 single. A sitar part was tried in session; the released version uses fuzz guitar on a minor-key riff.
body.zh: Beck 时期 1965 年单曲。录音时试过 sitar；发行版用 fuzz 吉他弹小调 riff。

body.en: 1966 single, about two and a half minutes. Beck’s solo uses feedback swells. The lyric addresses war and social change.
body.zh: 1966 年单曲，约两分半。Beck 独奏含反馈延音。歌词涉及战争与社会变化。

interviewQuotes.text: The rave-ups were arranged chaos. That was the lesson.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jeff Beck

interviewQuotes.text: Shapes of Things was feedback as composition.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jeff Beck

note.en: Beck between Clapton and Page. Includes Heart Full of Soul, Shapes of Things, and Roger the Engineer.
note.zh: Beck 介于 Clapton 与 Page 之间。包括 Heart Full of Soul、Shapes of Things 与 Roger the Engineer。

note.en: Beck-era single; feedback in the solo on a short pop form.
note.zh: Beck 时期单曲；短流行曲式上的反馈独奏。

note.en: R&B club band whose guitarists later led Cream and Led Zeppelin.
note.zh: R&B 俱乐部乐队；吉他手后来分别进入 Cream 与 Led Zeppelin。
